Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

August 27, 2026

Key decisions and points

  • Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor initiative. Engineering will build rather than buy: vendor options were costly and/or lacked required tax-code support.
  • The reconciliation rewrite is estimated at six engineer-weeks, including FX rounding migration, and needs Karim from Platform for two weeks of ledger integration support.
  • Mobile receipt capture v1 will ship without bulk receipt selection to protect capacity for reconciliation. Bulk-select is planned as a fast-follow roadmap item.
  • Mobile testing validated the flow but showed that the OCR confidence indicator must be made more prominent.
  • Vendor payout SLA: Finance wants a 48-hour payout guarantee from invoice approval; current p95 is 71 hours.
  • Meeting the 48-hour p95 target by mid-Q3 may require reducing ACH batching from 12 to 4 hours and adding a second west-coast approver. The engineering change is estimated at half a sprint and requires SRE sign-off due to additional monitoring.
  • Audit-log retention update is deferred to Q4, confirmed with Legal.
  • Internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern team; no scope changes.
  • Engineering bug-bash burnout needs attention; a rotating on-call proposal is requested.

Next steps / action items

  • Marcus: Confirm Karim’s availability with his manager this week.
  • Marcus and Jenna: Complete the ACH batching/SLA trade-off analysis and bring it back next week; proceed with the change if SRE finds monitoring manageable.
  • Dan: Update mobile receipt-capture specifications, including the stronger OCR confidence treatment, by Wednesday.
  • Marcus: Propose a rotating engineering on-call structure by August 31.
  • Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft Thursday morning for review and lock scope by Friday.
  • Sara: Present the finalized Q3 scope at the executive review on Monday.
